2609.22068.title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
2609.22068.paper_summary: Training capable coding agents via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse tasks with reliable verifiers. Open-source codebases offer a rich source of such tasks, while existing methods typically rely on development artifacts such as issues and commits, limiting the range of tasks that can be extracted. To better scale RL environments, we present CodeMidas, an agentic pipeline that turns implemented functionality in existing codebases into executable RL environments using source code as its only task-specific input. CodeMidas allocates agentic compute to every stage of environment construction: agents explore implemented functionality to formulate behavioral specifications, construct tests grounded in execution of the original code, and validate and filter candidate tasks through execution checks and repeated solution rollouts. The resulting dataset has 5,545 training tasks from 3,185 open-source codebases spanning 23 programming languages and 15 technical domains. Training MiMo-V2.5 on these tasks with GRPO improves performance on all five diverse benchmarks, covering issue repair (DeepSWE + 11.7%), whole-program construction (ProgramBench +17%), and terminal work (Terminal-Bench v2.1 +8.5%). Ablations show that increasing the number of high-quality training tasks improves performance. Trajectory analysis shows the RL-trained agent demonstrates better behaviors like increasing codebase exploration and more diverse self-verification. These results establish source code as a scalable foundation for constructing RL environments that improve coding agents across diverse software tasks.
2609.22068.paper_summary_zh: 訓練能夠編碼的代理人透過強化學習（RL）需要多樣化的任務和可靠的驗證者。開源代碼庫提供了這類任務的豐富來源，而現有的方法通常依賴於開發工件，如問題和提交，這限制了可以提取的任務範圍。為了更好地擴展RL環境，我們提出了CodeMidas，一個代理管道，將現有代碼庫中實現的功能轉換為可執行的RL環境，並以源代碼作為唯一的任務特定輸入。CodeMidas在環境構建的每個階段分配代理計算：代理探索已實現的功能以制定行為規範，構建基於原始代碼執行的測試，並通過執行檢查和重複解決方案推出來驗證和篩選候選任務。結果數據集包含來自3,185個開源代碼庫的5,545個訓練任務，涵蓋23種編程語言和15個技術領域。在這些任務上訓練MiMo-V2.5與GRPO相比，改善了所有五個多樣化基準的性能，包括問題修復（DeepSWE + 11.7%）、整個程序構建（ProgramBench +17%）和終端工作（Terminal-Bench v2.1 +8.5%）。消融實驗顯示，增加高質量訓練任務的數量可以提高性能。軌跡分析顯示，經RL訓練的代理表現出更好的行為，如增加代碼庫探索和更具多樣性的自我驗證。這些結果確立了源代碼作為構建RL環境的可擴展基礎，從而改善了在多樣化軟件任務中的編碼代理。
